activation_gate.decision: Do not train, screen, promote, or compare NicheCompass in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: An authoritative, rights-cleared donor-level spatial RNA dataset with reusable counts, coordinates, donor and section joins, outcome-independent boundary masks, weight-redistribution permission, and enough donors for a predeclared held-donor design.
activation_gate.task_gate: Register a spatial task, endpoint, biological unit, mandatory transcript-native baselines, power analysis, and external source before any superiority or champion claim.

gse192741.biological_units: 4 donors represented by 5 sections; one donor contributes 2 sections
gse192741.model_modality_fit: Native Visium RNA input is possible in principle after exact feature and coordinate admission.
gse192741.reference_issue: Space Ranger 1.0 hg19 was declared, but the exact annotation package and GRCh38.p14 gene crosswalk are unresolved.
gse192741.why: Four donors cannot support the planned external donor-level claim. Source outcomes are already exposed, and HEST-1k copies are duplicate representations, not additional donors.

gse292268.biological_units: 4 F2 MASLD donors distributed two per slide
gse292268.model_modality_fit: CosMx RNA is a native spatial-transcript count modality in principle, subject to assay-specific feature and count handling.
gse292268.why: Slides and fields of view are technical units, not donors. The donor map and morphology asset are unresolved, and four donors cannot support superiority.

hra007511.biological_units: 61-participant union; 35 spatial participants; only 3 participants overlap the scRNA and spatial subsets
hra007511.model_modality_fit: Spatial RNA alone is native. H&E and MALDI are not native NicheCompass observations. Optional RNA-ATAC is not supplied by this source.
hra007511.why: Processed spatial assets require permission, weight-redistribution rights require written approval, and participant-level joins are not admitted.

vu2025.biological_units: 33 biopsies from 32 participants; one participant contributes two synchronous cores
vu2025.model_modality_fit: Visium RNA is native in principle. CODEX and H&E are not native NicheCompass observations.
vu2025.pairing: Ten VLP capture arrays each hold biopsies from four to five participants; barcode-to-biopsy and participant boundaries are unresolved.
vu2025.why: A data-sharing agreement is required, public CODEX-to-Visium transforms are incomplete, and a graph built across a capture array would create cross-participant edges.

donor_and_graph_firewall.multiple_sections: All sections, cores, fields, and arrays from one participant remain in one outer fold.
donor_and_graph_firewall.technical_units: Spot, cell, field of view, section, core, slide, capture array, run, and graph node are not biological replicates.
donor_and_graph_firewall.graph_scope: Build graphs within authoritative participant and section boundaries, then use block-diagonal batching. No cross-participant, cross-core, cross-section, or cross-slide edge is allowed by default.
donor_and_graph_firewall.query_graph: A held donor's coordinates may form its own graph under a precommitted outcome-blind rule. Graph construction from pooled train and held coordinates is prohibited.
donor_and_graph_firewall.preprocessing: Gene filtering, normalization parameters, program selection, graph hyperparameters, clustering, label mapping, calibration, and any reference atlas are fit inside training donors only.
donor_and_graph_firewall.inference_unit: Inferential uncertainty resamples donors or participants, not nodes.

topology_and_missingness.allowed_pairing: Optional RNA-ATAC objectives require same-cell or same-nucleus observations. None of the four current spatial candidates supplies an admitted same-observation RNA-ATAC topology.
topology_and_missingness.histology: Presence of a registered H&E image is separate observed evidence, not a NicheCompass feature unless a new, explicitly audited image encoder is added.
topology_and_missingness.maldi: Adjacent-section MALDI cannot be entered as if measured on a transcriptomic spot.
topology_and_missingness.codex: CODEX proteins cannot be filled into an RNA or ATAC channel and unresolved registration remains join_unresolved.
topology_and_missingness.missing_states: Use observed, structurally_missing, not_applicable, below_qc, unavailable_permission, join_unresolved, withheld_sealed, and derivable_not_processed. Never encode unavailable assays, genes, priors, or joins as biological zero.

held_donor_evaluation.frozen_lane: Freeze weights, gene and prior-program orders, normalization, graph recipe, sample-covariate policy, prototype or cluster mapping, and all hyperparameters before encoding a held donor.
held_donor_evaluation.query_adaptive_lane: Any query fine-tuning, reference mapping update, new sample embedding, prototype adaptation, or clustering using held features is a separately reported transductive lane.
held_donor_evaluation.labels: Held disease, fibrosis, niche, cell-type, or outcome labels cannot affect graph construction, training, clustering resolution, mapping, thresholding, or calibration.
held_donor_evaluation.claim_limit: No current source supplies a project-sealed, adequately powered donor-level endpoint. Therefore no NicheCompass result can be a v1 champion result.

training_corpus_and_prior_crosswalk.external_prior_assets: UNRESOLVED; NicheNet, OmniPath, CollecTRI, ortholog, and metabolite tables must each be frozen and terms-audited before use.
training_corpus_and_prior_crosswalk.target_exposure_interpretation: A correctly donor-folded local model could be target_label_unexposed for its held donors, but no such model or eligible dataset exists.

interpretation: NicheCompass is scientifically relevant for a future donor-resolved spatial RNA niche track, not for the active v1 tournament. Its spatial graph is an input with its own leakage surface, its optional RNA-ATAC path requires true same-observation pairing, and its priors are versioned external evidence rather than free model metadata. The current MASLD spatial sources are too small, controlled, join-unresolved, exposed, or non-native for a held-back superiority claim.
